blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) – Acrylic Photo Prints & Archival Prints

Q1: What is an acrylic photo print? A: An acrylic photo print is a photo or artwork printed on high-quality paper and mounted between clear acrylic sheets. This gives your image a glossy, vibrant, and modern look, adding depth and richness to colors.

Q2: Can I get an acrylic photo print with a frame? A: Yes, you can choose framed acrylic prints. Frames not only enhance the look but also protect the print. You can select from various frame styles to match your décor.

Q3: How thick is the acrylic used for prints? A: We use 3 mm or 5 mm thick clear acrylic sheets, which are sturdy, lightweight, and shatter-resistant. Larger prints come with stainless steel studs for added support.

Q4: How long will my acrylic photo print last? A: With proper care, acrylic prints can last for decades. They are resistant to UV light, moisture, and discoloration, keeping your images bright and sharp for years.

Q5: Can I customize the size of my acrylic photo print? A: Yes, you can order any size between 8x8 inches to 48x96 inches. Our platform also recommends the best dimensions based on your image resolution.

Q6: Can I preview my image before ordering? A: Absolutely! Our online service allows you to preview and adjust your image, ensuring your print looks exactly how you want it before you place the order.

Q7: Can I use acrylic photo prints outdoors? A: Acrylic prints are mainly for indoor use. Direct sunlight or harsh weather may reduce the lifespan of the print’s colors. For outdoor display, choose a shaded or covered area.

Q8: Can I add text, logos, or captions to my print? A: Yes, you can personalize your acrylic print with text, logos, or other design elements. Our online design tool makes customization simple and intuitive.

Q9: How do I hang or mount my acrylic photo print? A: Our prints come with adhesive backings or mounting studs depending on the size. Simply peel and stick for smaller prints, or use the stainless steel studs for larger pieces.

Q10: How do I clean and maintain my acrylic photo print? A: Use a soft, lint-free cloth to wipe the surface. Avoid abrasive cleaners or rough fabrics. For stubborn spots, a mild soap solution can be used, then dry gently with a clean cloth.

Q11: What are the benefits of acrylic photo prints? A: Acrylic prints provide vibrant colors, modern glossy finishes, shatter-resistance, and long-lasting durability. They give depth and clarity to every image and work perfectly for home, office, or galleries.

**Q12: How are acrylic photo prints made?** A: The process involves printing your image on archival-quality paper, then mounting it between two acrylic sheets. Advanced printing technology ensures sharp details, accurate colors, and a museum-quality finish.

blocks.text: Face Mounting at Framing World — Give Your Art a Stunning, Gallery-Grade Finish

At Framing World, we’re all about bringing your visuals to life with our top-notch [Face Mounting services.](/) If you’re looking to make your photographs or artwork pop with boldness and vibrancy, face mounting is the way to go. It’s a modern finishing technique that turns an ordinary print into a stunning, gallery-worthy masterpiece that grabs attention right away.
What Is Face Mounting?

Face mounting is a unique process where a printed image is placed directly behind a clear acrylic sheet. First, we print your image on high-quality photo or archival paper, and then we use a crystal-clear adhesive to attach it to the back of a polished acrylic surface. The result? A smooth, glossy finish that really enhances the color depth, clarity, and vibrancy of your artwork.

Since the print is positioned right behind the acrylic, light passes through the surface, giving the artwork a captivating three-dimensional look. This is what makes face-mounted prints so eye-catching, especially in modern interiors and upscale display settings.
Why Choose Face Mounting?

items: Stunning Clarity & Depth

blocks.text: The acrylic surface really brings out the details, contrast, and color accuracy, making your image pop with a depth and vibrancy that traditional framing just can't match.

items: Sleek, Modern Look

blocks.text: With face-mounted prints, there's no need for bulky frames or matting. The frameless design offers a clean, contemporary vibe that fits perfectly in homes, galleries, offices, studios, and commercial spaces.

items: Durable Protection

How do I make a purchase?

How do I know if my order is confirmed?

Once your order has been successfully placed, you will receive an order confirmation notification on your registered email address or mobile number, subject to the contact details provided. Your order will then be processed by our team. If you do not receive a confirmation, please contact us at **+91 9818040566** or email us at [**framingworld@gmail.com**](mailto:framingworld@gmail.com).
